summary: Sometimes the opportunity you wanted becomes serious the moment you realize how much responsibility comes with getting to keep it.
body: Sometimes the opportunity you wanted becomes serious the moment you realize how much responsibility comes with getting to keep it. When Jupiter conjuncts Saturn, expansion and obligation arrive together, making a larger role, commitment, or long-term plan possible precisely because there are now rules, deadlines, costs, and expectations around it. The structure is not necessarily what is standing between you and the opportunity; it may be what makes the opportunity sustainable. Make sure you want the responsibility as much as you wanted the possibility.
